outcome: risk factors for emergency postpartum hysterectomy
number of red cell units transfused
cohort: 152,023 women who gave birth at Fujian Maternity and Children Health Hospital between January 2004 and June 2016
finding: Caesarean deliveries were associated with an increased risk of emergency hysterectomy, and postpartum prothrombin activity < 50% was the greatest risk factor for hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were associated with an increased risk of emergency hysterectomy.
